correctness.rationale: Block rank identity, compatible linear section, row-column normal form, surjective restriction B -> Hom(ker D,coker A), and Gaussian matrix counts prove every stratum. The nullity limit is justified by a uniform summable bound. The packaged checker reproduces all tested strata and 2x2 regularity by full inner-inverse enumeration. Prime-power generality is proved, not extrapolated.

value.rationale: Provides a natural complete defect invariant tied to von Neumann regularity, exact counts for arbitrary block sizes and fields, a unit double-orbit refinement and a stable nonzero nonregular probability. This characterizes a structural obstruction absent from full matrix monoids and quantitatively distinguishes fixed-length flag preservation from scalar triangular structure.
